definitionZh: 网格行 CSS 的短手属性通过给其网格位置贡献一条线,一个跨,或一无所有(自动)来指定网格项目在网格行内的大小和位置,从而指定其网格区域的内始和内端边缘.
sourceDefinition: The grid-row CSS shorthand property specifies a grid item's size and location within a grid row by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-start and inline-end edge of its grid areas.
